blocking_finding.title: The fixed SCP archive pathname is mutated before it is authenticated
blocking_finding.evidence: preflight_program contains neither REMOTE_ARCHIVE nor REMOTE_STAGE. run() creates the local attempt marker and calls fixed_scp_argv() before REMOTE_RECONCILER checks archive lstat and SHA.
blocking_finding.counterexample: If /tmp/m1203_m1180_missing2_monotonic_transport_r1.tar already names a symlink or another nonregular object, SCP/SFTP can follow or overwrite it before the later verifier runs.
blocking_finding.why_local_archive_tests_do_not_close_it: validate_archive_to_stage tests tar members only after a local archive pathname is already trusted; they do not model the pre-verification remote pathname mutation performed by SCP.
blocking_finding.required_successor: Create an exclusive unpredictable remote temporary directory/path over authenticated SSH, validate its anchored path and lstat/ownership/mode, SCP only inside it, then verify archive lstat/size/SHA before extraction; alternatively stream the archive over SSH without a remote pathname. Seal a new identity and obtain a different-author hammer.
